G4500.et: from a derivative of rhoizos (a whir)
G4500.def: adverb from a derivative of rhoizos (a whir); whizzingly, i.e. with a crash:--with a great noise.

G4501.def: probably of foreign origin; a sabre, i.e. a long and broad cutlass (any weapon of the kind, literally or figuratively):--sword.

G4502.def: of Hebrew origin («07205»); Ruben (i.e. Reuben), an Israelite:--Reuben.

G4503.def: of Hebrew origin («07327»); Ruth, a Moabitess:--Ruth.

G4504.def: of Latin origin; red; Rufus, a Christian:--Rufus.

G4505.et: prolongation from (4506) in its original sense
G4505.def: prolongation from «4506» in its original sense; an alley or avenue (as crowded):--lane, street.

G4506.et: middle voice of an obsolete verb, akin to (4482) (through the idea of a current, cf (4511))
G4506.def: middle voice of an obsolete verb, akin to «4482» (through the idea of a current; compare «4511»); to rush or draw (for oneself), i.e. rescue:--deliver(-er).

G4508.def: from «4509»; dirty, i.e. (relatively) cheap or shabby; morally, wicked:--vile.

G4509.def: of uncertain affinity; dirt, i.e. (morally) depravity:--filth.

G4510.def: from «4509»; to soil, i.e. (intransitively) to become dirty (morally):--be filthy.

G4511.et: from (4506) in the sense of its congener (4482)
G4511.def: from «4506» in the sense of its congener «4482»; a flux (of blood):--issue.

G4512.def: from «4506»; a fold (as drawing together), i.e. a wrinkle (especially on the face):--wrinkle.

G4514.def: from «4516»; Romaean, i.e. Roman (as noun):--Roman, of Rome.

G4515.def: adverb from a presumed derivative of «4516»; Romaistically, i.e. in the Latin language:--Latin.

G4516.def: from the base of «4517»; strength; Roma, the capital of Italy:--Rome.

G4517.et: prolongation from rhoomai (to dart, probably akin to (4506))
G4517.def: prolongation from rhoomai (to dart; probably akin to «4506»); to strengthen, i.e. (impersonal passive) have health (as a parting exclamation, good-bye):--farewell.

G4518.et: of Aramaic or (07662) with pronominal suffix
G4518.def: of Chaldee or (7662 with pronominal suffix); thou hast left me; sabachthani (i.e. shebakthani), a cry of distress:--sabachthani.

G4519.et: of Hebrew origin (06635) in feminine plural
G4519.def: of Hebrew origin (6635 in feminine plural); armies; sabaoth (i.e. tsebaoth), a military epithet of God:--sabaoth.

G4520.def: from a derivative of «4521»; a "sabbatism", i.e. (figuratively) the repose of Christianity (as a type of heaven):--rest.

G4521.def: of Hebrew origin («07676»); the Sabbath (i.e. Shabbath), or day of weekly repose from secular avocations (also the observance or institution itself); by extension, a se'nnight, i.e. the interval between two Sabbaths; likewise the plural in all the above applications:--sabbath (day), week.

G4522.et: from a derivative of satto (to equip) meaning furniture, especially a pack-saddle (which in the East is merely a bag of netted rope)
G4522.def: from a derivative of satto (to equip) meaning furniture, especially a pack-saddle (which in the East is merely a bag of netted rope); a "seine" for fishing:--net.

G4523.def: probably from «4524»; a Sadducaean (i.e. Tsadokian), or follower of a certain heretical Israelite:--Sadducee.

G4524.def: of Hebrew origin («06659»); Sadoc (i.e. Tsadok), an Israelite:--Sadoc.

G4525.def: akin to «4579»; to wag (as a dog its tail fawningly), i.e. (generally) to shake (figuratively, disturb):--move.

G4526.def: of Hebrew origin («08242»); "sack"-cloth, i.e. mohair (the material or garments made of it, worn as a sign of grief):-- sackcloth.

G4527.def: of Hebrew origin («07974»); Sala (i.e. Shelach), a patriarch :--Sala.

G4528.def: of Hebrew origin («07597»); Salathiel (i.e. Shealtiel), an Israelite:--Salathiel.

G4529.et: probably from (4535) (from the surge on the shore)
G4529.def: probably from «4535» (from the surge on the shore); Salamis, a place in Cyprus:--Salamis.

G4530.def: probably from the same as «4531»; Salim, a place in Palestine:--Salim.

G4531.def: from «4535»; to waver, i.e. agitate, rock, topple or (by implication) destroy; figuratively, to disturb, incite:--move, shake (together), which can(-not) be shaken, stir up.

G4532.def: of Hebrew origin («08004»); Salem (i.e. Shalem), a place in Palestine:--Salem.

G4533.def: of Hebrew origin («08012»); Salmon, an Israelite:--Salmon.

G4534.def: perhaps of similar origin to «4529»; Salmone, a place in Crete:--Salmone.

G4535.def: probably from the base of «4525»; a vibration, i.e. (specially), billow:--wave.

G4536.et: perhaps from (4535) (through the idea of quavering or reverberation)
G4536.def: perhaps from «4535» (through the idea of quavering or reverberation); a trumpet:--trump(-et).

G4537.def: from «4536»; to trumpet, i.e. sound a blast (literally or figuratively):--(which are yet to) sound (a trumpet).

G4539.def: probably of Hebrew origin (feminine from «07965»); Salome (i.e. Shelomah), an Israelitess:--Salome.

G4540.def: of Hebrew origin («08111»); Samaria (i.e. Shomeron), a city and region of Palestine:--Samaria.

G4541.def: from «4540»; a Samarite, i.e. inhabitant of Samaria:--Samaritan.

G4542.def: feminine of «4541»; a Samaritess, i.e. woman of Samaria:--of Samaria.

G4543.def: from «4544» and Thraike (Thrace); Samo-thrace (Samos of Thrace), an island in the Mediterranean:--Samothracia.

G4544.def: of uncertain affinity; Samus, an island of the Mediterranean:--Samos.

G4545.def: of Hebrew origin («08050»); Samuel (i.e. Shemuel), an Israelite:--Samuel.

G4546.def: of Hebrew origin («08123»); Sampson (i.e. Shimshon), an Israelite:--Samson.

G4547.et: from a derivative of sandalon (a "sandal"; of uncertain origin)
G4547.def: neuter of a derivative of sandalon (a "sandal"; of uncertain origin); a slipper or sole-pad:--sandal.

G4549.def: of Hebrew origin («07586»); Saul (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul:--Saul. Compare «4569».

G4550.def: from «4595»; rotten, i.e. worthless (literally or morally):--bad, corrupt. Compare «4190».

G4552.def: of Hebrew origin («05601»); a "sapphire" or lapis-lazuli gem:--sapphire.

G4553.def: apparently of Hebrew origin («08276»); a basket (as interwoven or wicker-work:--basket.

G4554.def: plural of uncertain derivation; Sardis, a place in Asia Minor:--Sardis.

G4555.def: from the same as «4556»; sardine (3037 being implied), i.e. a gem, so called:--sardine.

G4556.et: properly, an adjective from an uncertain base
G4556.def: properly, an adjective from an uncertain base; sardian (3037 being implied), i.e. (as noun) the gem so called:--sardius.

G4557.et: from the base of (4556) and onux (the nail of a finger, hence the "onyx" stone)
G4557.def: from the base of «4556» and onux (the nail of a finger; hence the "onyx" stone); a "sardonyx", i.e. the gem so called:-- sardonyx.

G4558.def: of Hebrew origin («06886»); Sarepta (i.e. Tsarephath), a place in Palestine:--Sarepta.

G4559.def: from «4561»; pertaining to flesh, i.e. (by extension) bodily, temporal, or (by implication) animal, unregenerate:--carnal, fleshly.

G4560.def: from «4561»; similar to flesh, i.e. (by analogy) soft:--fleshly.

G4561.def: probably from the base of «4563»; flesh (as stripped of the skin), i.e. (strictly) the meat of an animal (as food), or (by extension) the body (as opposed to the soul (or spirit), or as the symbol of what is external, or as the means of kindred), or (by implication) human nature (with its frailties (physically or morally) and passions), or (specially), a human being (as such):--carnal(-ly, + -ly minded), flesh(-ly).

G4562.def: of Hebrew origin («08286»); Saruch (i.e. Serug), a patriarch:--Saruch.

G4563.et: from a derivative of sairo (to brush off, akin to (4951))
G4563.def: from a derivative of sairo (to brush off; akin to «4951»); meaning a broom; to sweep:--sweep.

G4564.def: of Hebrew origin («08283»); Sarra (i.e. Sarah), the wife of Abraham:--Sara, Sarah.

G4565.def: of Hebrew origin («08289»); Saron (i.e. Sharon), a district of Palestine:--Saron.

G4566.def: of Hebrew origin («07854»); Satan, i.e. the devil:--Satan. Compare «4567».

G4567.et: of Aramaic origin corresponding to (4566) (with the definite affix)
G4567.def: of Chaldee origin corresponding to «04566» (with the definite affix); the accuser, i.e. the devil:--Satan.

G4568.def: of Hebrew origin («05429»); a certain measure for things dry:--measure.

G4569.et: of Hebrew origin, the same as (4549)
G4569.def: of Hebrew origin, the same as «4549»; Saulus (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul:--Saul.

G4570.et: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb
G4570.def: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb; to extinguish (literally or figuratively):--go out, quench.

G4571.def: accusative case singular of «4771»; thee:--thee, thou, × thy house.

G4572.def: sautoi sow-to', and sauton sow-ton', respectively of (with, to) thyself:--thee, thine own self, (thou) thy(-self).

G4573.et: middle voice from a derivative of (4576)
G4573.def: middle voice from a derivative of «4576»; to venerate, i.e. adore:--worship.

G4574.def: from «4573»; something adored, i.e. an object of worship (god, altar, etc):--devotion, that is worshipped.

G4575.def: from «4573»; venerable (august), i.e. (as noun) a title of the Roman Emperor, or (as adjective) imperial:--Augustus(-').

G4576.et: middle voice of an apparently primary verb
G4576.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to revere, i.e. adore:--devout, religious, worship.

G4577.et: probably from (4951) through its congener eiro (to fasten, akin to (138))
G4577.def: probably from «4951» through its congener eiro (to fasten; akin to «138»); a chain (as binding or drawing):--chain.

G4578.def: from «4579»; a commotion, i.e. (of the air) a gale, (of the ground) an earthquake:--earthquake, tempest.

G4579.def: apparently a primary verb; to rock (vibrate, properly, sideways or to and fro), i.e. (generally) to agitate (in any direction; cause to tremble); figuratively, to throw into a tremor (of fear or concern):--move, quake, shake.

G4580.def: of Latin origin; "second"; Secundus, a Christian:--Secundus.

G4581.def: from Seleukos (Seleucus, a Syrian king); Seleuceia, a place in Syria:--Seleucia.

G4582.et: from selas (brilliancy, probably akin to the alternate of (138), through the idea of attractiveness)
G4582.def: from selas (brilliancy; probably akin to the alternate of «138», through the idea of attractiveness); the moon:--moon.

G4583.et: middle voice or passive from a presumed derivative of (4582)
G4583.def: middle voice or passive from a presumed derivative of «4582»; to be moon-struck, i.e. crazy:--be a lunatic.

G4584.def: of Hebrew origin («08096»); Semei (i.e. Shimi), an Israelite:--Semei.

G4585.def: probably of foreign origin; fine wheaten flour:--fine flour.

G4588.def: of Latin origin; Sergius, a Roman:--Sergius.

G4589.def: of Hebrew origin («08352»); Seth (i.e. Sheth), a patriarch:--Seth.

G4590.def: of Hebrew origin («08035»); Sem (i.e. Shem), a patriarch:-- Sem.

G4591.et: from sema (a mark, of uncertain derivation)
G4591.def: from sema (a mark; of uncertain derivation); to indicate:--signify.

G4592.et: from a presumed derivative of the base of (4591)
G4592.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of «4591»; an indication, especially ceremonially or supernaturally:--miracle, sign, token, wonder.

G4593.def: from «4592»; to distinguish, i.e. mark (for avoidance):--note.

G4594.et: neuter (as adverb) of a presumed compound of the art. (3588) and (2250), on the (i.e. this) day (or night current or just passed)
G4594.def: neuter (as adverb) of a presumed compound of the article «3588» (t changed to s) and «2250»; on the (i.e. this) day (or night current or just passed); generally, now (i.e. at present, hitherto):--this (to-)day.

G4595.def: apparently a primary verb; to putrefy, i.e. (figuratively) perish:--be corrupted.

G4596.et: from Ser (an Indian tribe from whom silk was procured, hence the name of the silk-worm)
G4596.def: from Ser (an Indian tribe from whom silk was procured; hence the name of the silk-worm); Seric, i.e. silken (neuter as noun, a silky fabric):--silk.

G4597.def: apparently of Hebrew origin («05580»); a moth:--moth.

G4598.def: from «4597» and a derivative of «977»; moth-eaten:--motheaten.

G4599.et: from sthenos (bodily vigour, probably akin to the base of (2476))
G4599.def: from sthenos (bodily vigor; probably akin to the base of «2476»); to strengthen, i.e. (figuratively) confirm (in spiritual knowledge and power):--strengthen.
